Hi Samantha and Tom,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- What we heard: BrightPath is focused on a phased pilot for inference at scale, prioritizing latency under 200ms for customer-facing features and predictable unit cost.
- Proposed pilot: 2-week sandbox, 3 endpoints, 1M tokens/day load profile; we included both hosted and private deployment options in the estimate.
- Cost snapshot: ballpark ranges are in the attached estimate; we highlighted a Dedicated option for predictable throughput.

Attachments included: Redwood_BP_Estimate_20260302.pdf and redwood_pricing_reference_v3.pdf

If it helps, I can run a short ops sync to walk through the integration/connection steps and the timeline implications of Dedicated vs Hosted. Suggested slots: Tue 3/9 9:00-9:30 PST or Wed 3/10 11:00-11:30 PST.

If you have an internal budget or decision timeline, send that over and we will tailor the proposal.

Thanks,
